groups.title: belly 月
groups.note: Flesh on the left: the soft middle of the body.

chars.story: The flesh that sags toward the ground: belly.
The flesh that goes round and round: abdomen.
chars.note: The formal word; 肚 is the everyday one.

chars.parts: 月 flesh + 汤's right half (sound)
chars.story: A long tube of flesh coiled inside: intestines.
The soft flesh stored under the skin: body fat.
Flesh that keeps growing bigger: bloated.
A bulge in the middle of the flesh: swollen.
Flesh in danger of snapping: brittle.
A heart at ease: pleased.
A heart opening up: delighted.
The heart finally says 'I see': comprehend.

chars.parts: 忄 heart + 脑's right half (sound)
chars.story: A heart in a tangle: angry.
A heart going out to someone it wants to be like: admire.
A heart bowing along with the others: respectful.
A heart that pulls itself away: dread.

groups.title: hand 扌 and tap 攵

chars.story: A hand pulling until it stops: tug.
A hand that knows its way round a craft: be good at.
A hand lunging forward: pounce.
A hand grabbing at a running foot: clutch.
Hands raising something up onto a platform: lift up.
A tap at something high up: knock.
A mouth taking in the whole sky: swallow.
A mouth crossing its teeth over something: bite.
Putting food into a mouth: feed.
chars.note: Also 'hey!' on the phone. Traditional 餵 had 饣 food on the left.

chars.story: A mouth letting out a breath, a hand at the chest: sigh.
A mouth imitating a clap: bang.

chars.parts: 衣 clothes with 口 mouth set inside
chars.story: A mouth wailing inside mourning clothes: grief.
A stroke of the axe in words: blame.

chars.parts: 马 horse + 爻 crossed strokes
chars.story: A horse kicking back: refute.
A mouth blowing out sharply: scold.
chars.note: Mostly in 呵斥 'rebuke'; 呵呵 is a chuckle.

chars.story: Words passed from mouth to mouth: rumour.
chars.note: Traditional 謠: 訁 became 讠.

chars.story: Words sent out against someone: censure.
chars.note: Traditional 譴: 訁 became 讠.

chars.story: Words that blow barbs through the air: satirise.
chars.note: Traditional 諷: 訁 became 讠.

chars.story: Words one would break before breaking: a vow.
Held over fire until it tests done: roast.
A little oil over fierce fire: stir-fry.
Food wrapped up inside you: full up.
chars.note: Traditional 飽: 食 became 饣.

chars.story: Stone slabs standing out in the water: jetty.
chars.note: Traditional 磯. Meets it only in these names.

chars.story: A stone blade swung down: chop.
Stone-hard charcoal: carbon.
A big wooden box: cabinet.
A piece of wood you sit on: chair.
Wood set round an empty space: frame.
Wood cut up for the fire: firewood.
A dish with its lid joined on: a small box.
A net thrown over something: a hood.
chars.note: Also a cover or shade: 口罩 'face mask', 灯罩 'lampshade'.

chars.story: Woven bamboo to hold a fierce creature: cage.
A whole team dropping to the ground: plunge.
Earth firm enough to bear a load: can bear.
Fine earth for planting: soil.

groups.title: farming
groups.note: The land and what lives on it.

chars.story: A plough turning the earth at the village well: plow.
A plot of field: the mu.
chars.note: Traditional 畝. A Chinese unit of area, about a sixth of an acre.

chars.story: The animals kept on the farm: livestock.
A roofed passage along a wall: corridor.

chars.parts: - a small hill with two peaks on flat ground
chars.story: Two peaks rising from flat ground: mound.
Flat earth by a river: found in place names.
chars.note: A place-name character, as in 柬埔寨 'Cambodia'.

chars.story: Where the roads cross out of town: outskirts.
A town with plenty, thick with growth: lush.
chars.note: Traditional 鬱. Today it mostly means 'gloomy' in words.

chars.story: The wall round a town: outer wall.
The first child at the dish: eldest.
chars.note: Also a surname: 孟子 is Mencius.

chars.story: Two sides before a court speaking: an old word for a group; now a surname.
Shells bought and sold in the west: merchant.
The animal with a tail like a melon vine: fox.
A dog's nose, and what it finds: smelly.
A plant whose seeds join in one pod: lotus.
A plant that goes to seed in tiny grains: sesame.

chars.parts: 宀 roof + 八 two sides
chars.story: A roof over a hollow, split into two sides: cave.
Cutting a way into a cave: steal secretly.
A person who has gone far away: emigrant.
A person pressing you to hurry: hasten.
The bar the cart-wheels turn from: axle.
The bars running from hub to rim: spoke.
Gathering strength from the crowd: enlist.
Cloth handed over as tax: hand in.
chars.note: Traditional 繳: 糸 became 纟.

chars.story: A person put to use: employ.
A sheep at the altar: a good omen.

chars.parts: - a roofed tower on a small base
chars.story: A tower standing tall, all going well: smooth-going.
The king-sun at its height: blooming.
Strength surging up: thriving.
Up earlier than everyone else: preeminent.
A body curled out of shape: bent.
The curve of a bow: bend.
A curled hook: hook.
A cloth hanging from a ring: hang up.
The low sun beating down on the washing: dry in the sun.

chars.parts: - a mouth open with a tongue inside
chars.story: A mouth open with the tongue moving inside: say.
chars.note: Same as in the Analects, but now only in written, literary prose.

chars.parts: - a moon half seen at dusk
chars.story: A moon half seen at the edge of day: dusk.
chars.note: Same as in the Analects; modern use is mostly in 夕阳 and 前夕.

chars.story: An eye closes once: a wink, an instant.
A body lying still: lie down.
A tongue sticking out of a mouth.
The mark an illness or wound leaves: scar.
A woman putting herself in order: makeup.
A woman on your mother's side: aunt.
Water pushing up through a narrow channel: gush.

chars.parts: 氵 water + 巨 huge + 木 wood
chars.story: A big wooden channel carrying water: canal.

chars.parts: - a long shaft with a blade angled across the top
chars.story: The old weapon, a dagger-axe.
chars.note: A part in 伐, 战 and 我.

chars.story: Fish and grain, the food that brings life back: the name Jesus.
chars.note: Only in 耶稣 'Jesus'. Traditional 穌.

chars.parts: 尸 body + 口 mouth + 辛 bitter
chars.story: A body cutting its mouth into hard ground: open up.
chars.note: Also 精辟 'incisive'. Traditional 闢 in the sense 'open'.

chars.story: A gate opened onto an explanation: disclose.
chars.note: Traditional 闡: 門 became 门.

chars.story: Tucked in a box where nobody can see: hide out.
Metal honed to a point: acute.
chars.note: Traditional 銳: 金 became 钅.

sentences.en: He vowed to give up smoking.
He is not a good driver.
When happiness comes knocking at your door.
Kyoko is lying on the grass.
The tiger laid in the middle of the cage.

sentences.zh: 学习新的知识令人愉悦。
sentences.en: Learning new information can make people happy.

sentences.zh: 这收音机不比火柴盒大。
sentences.en: This radio is no bigger than a matchbox.

sentences.zh: 我刚打开锅盖，一股恶臭就扑鼻而来。
sentences.en: I just opened the lid, and a foul smell filled my nose.

sentences.zh: 重庆是一座丘陵的城市，道路弯弯曲曲的。
sentences.en: Chongqing is a hilly city with winding streets.
